issues.description: isIncluded's postcondition depends on mutable changedFiles state set by onTestRunStart
issues.detail: isIncluded was a pure function of filename plus glob config; now it silently depends on this.changedFiles, which is populated later by onTestRunStart. The globCache.clear() papers over the staleness, but the method's answer now varies by lifecycle phase. Resolve a ChangedFilesSet once at config-resolve time and pass it explicitly into isIncluded/getUntestedFiles.

issues.description: Path normalization contract between VitestGit/config.related and isIncluded is implicit and may not align
issues.detail: isIncluded calls this.changedFiles.includes(slash(cleanUrl(filename))), but VitestGit.findChangedFiles and ctx.config.related typically yield absolute paths in their own shape. The raw string membership test relies on undocumented normalization across providers/platforms. Canonicalize once at assignment in onTestRunStart and document the shape.

issues.description: changedFiles stored as string[] with O(n) .includes on the isIncluded hot path
issues.detail: isIncluded runs per file and does array membership lookup against changedFiles. With many changed files this is O(n*m) on a hot path. Build a Set<string> once in onTestRunStart for O(1) lookup; the cache-invalidation story is unchanged.

issues.description: onTestRunStart wired manually at three call sites in core.ts, easy to forget on a fourth
issues.detail: core.ts invokes coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.() after each _testRun.start in three places. Any future entry point that forgets the call silently breaks coverage.changed. Consolidate: call it inside _testRun.start, or have generateCoverage lazily resolve changedFiles from a single source of truth.

issues.description: Two changed-file sources (options.changed vs ctx.config.related) conflated under one field at runtime
issues.detail: onTestRunStart branches between re-running git for options.changed and reading ctx.config.related computed by test.changed. These are different facts with different provenance, decided by an if/else at use time. Pick one source of truth in resolveConfig instead of branching twice (resolveConfig and onTestRunStart fallback).

issues.description: CLI changed transform duplicates boolean coercion and silently accepts typos as git refs
issues.detail: The inline transform special-cases 'true'/'yes'/'false'/'no' and treats everything else as a ref, so 'tru' or 'flase' become refs that fail confusingly inside VitestGit. It also duplicates yargs/boolean coercion likely already used by the sibling --changed option. Validate at the boundary and reuse the existing helper.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is well-scoped but adds incidental complexity around how "changed files" flows through the coverage provider. The core issue: isIncluded's contract now depends on mutable state (changedFiles) set by a separately-invoked lifecycle hook, with an implicit path-normalization contract and an O(n) array membership test on a hot path. The lifecycle hook is wired manually in three places in core.ts and the two changed-file sources (options.changed vs ctx.config.related) are conflated at runtime instead of at config-resolve time. Fix by resolving a single canonical Set<string> of normalized changed paths at config-resolve and passing it explicitly, plus tightening the CLI transform.
